task.goal: Refactor the current A2A/Storybook control policy so Doré is always-on and autonomous while ChatGPT is a conversation-activated asynchronous peer, without paid OpenAI API usage.

operating_model.dore: always-on autonomous worker and Storybook/Design Lab driver
operating_model.chatgpt: conversation-activated peer; absence is normal and must never block Doré ordinary work
operating_model.human: sets goals/direction; never acts as loop start/continue button

hard_invariants: No paid OpenAI API or other pay-per-token model dependency.
ChatGPT offline/not invoked is NORMAL, not a Doré failure condition.
Doré must continue useful Storybook/design/research work without waiting for ChatGPT.
Ordinary insufficient references, weak design quality, need for another design direction, or failed specimen must remain inside Doré autonomous local research/experiment loop.
A pending ChatGPT peer request must be durable and non-blocking: checkpoint it and continue another information-gaining action or another runnable goal.

Escalate to ChatGPT only for a genuine unresolved capability/knowledge boundary after Doré has exhausted distinct information-gaining local/free/OSS research paths, or for a decision that explicitly requires the human/ChatGPT conversation.
When ChatGPT later enters via user conversation, durable A2A state must allow it to discover pending requests/results and contribute; Doré then consumes that contribution asynchronously.
No WAITING_PEER state may freeze the resident Storybook/Design Lab loop.
Locked homepage #262 remains read-only unless the user explicitly changes direction.
required_engineering: Change Agent Core/research policy so PEER_RESEARCH_QUEUED is non-blocking for ordinary autonomous work.
Represent peer handoff as durable pending work rather than a global blocking state.
Ensure resident runtime continues selecting runnable autonomous actions/goals while a peer handoff is pending.
Update loop contract/runtime manifest/telemetry semantics to distinguish PENDING_PEER_NONBLOCKING from genuine HUMAN_GATE.
Remove or neutralize any higher-order supervisor behavior that treats absent ChatGPT as a stall requiring the whole project loop to wait.
Preserve provenance and exact research_id matching when a later ChatGPT response arrives.
Keep research local-first: Knowledge Lab, skills, failure memory, free public sources, mature OSS, local Storybook experiments.
Resume design-reference-library-expansion-20260901 autonomously and continue toward its existing acceptance gates.
acceptance: With no new ChatGPT response, Doré completes multiple autonomous Storybook/design-lab iterations and telemetry shows forward progress.
A pending peer request can coexist with active autonomous work and does not produce a global A2A_WAITING_PEER freeze.
User silence does not stop Storybook/design-lab progress.
When a matching peer response later appears, Doré consumes it by research_id and incorporates it without losing the parent goal.
No paid API is called or required.
Return canonical result with changed files, tests, telemetry evidence, and current design-reference acceptance counts.
